title: Connor Teskey on BAM’s Q3 fundraising and infrastructure growth with Bloomberg TV
description: Brookfield Asset Management CEO Connor Teskey joins Bloomberg TV’s Dani Burger to discuss the firm’s third-quarter fundraising momentum, growing investor demand for infrastructure and credit, and the investment opportunities emerging from the global build-out of AI infrastructure.
summary: The video discusses Brookfield's Q3 fundraising and infrastructure growth, contrasting its performance with Blackstone's rougher quarter driven by volatility and energy prices. It also highlights Brookfield's reliance on Bloom Energy as a critical supplier and operator for its data center projects to secure power supply. The overall argument is limited to these specific operational and comparative points.
